our original Fiscal 2026 Stretch Compensation Plan revenue goal of $190.0 billion was automatically adjusted to $160.0 billion, and our original Fiscal 2026 Stretch Compensation Plan Non-GAAP Operating Income goal of $120.0 billion was automatically adjusted to $96.0 billion, due to the imposition of additional export controls on the Company's H20 products during the first half of Fiscal 2026.

comp_disc_analysis.notes:
[chunk 1/3] This is a DEF 14A Compensation Discussion & Analysis section. The vast majority of the text is standard executive compensation boilerplate (PSU/RSU structures, peer benchmarking, pay mix philosophy) with no SIFI-material content. Two SIFI-material signals were extracted:

1. H20 EXPORT CONTROL / CHINA REVENUE RISK (Severity 3): The CC pre-embedded an automatic downward adjustment mechanism into FY2026 performance goals anticipating potential H20 export restrictions. The trigger fired in April 2025 when USG required a license for H20 exports to China. Revenue stretch goal was cut $30B (190→160B) and Non-GAAP OI goal cut $24B (120→96B). This is a quantified, disclosed regulatory revenue impact embedded in a compensation filing — SIFI-material because it sizes the China revenue dependency for NVIDIA's H20 product line.

2. CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION SIGNAL (Severity 2, watch): The CD&A narrative explicitly attributes FY2026's record $215.9B revenue to "Data Center demand for our Blackwell architecture" from cloud providers, hyperscalers, AI model makers — confirming continued concentration in a narrow set of large infrastructure buyers. No specific counterparty names or percentages are given in this section; those would need to be cross-referenced from the 10-K.

Peer group additions (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft) are compensation benchmarking boilerplate — not SIFI-material relationships. The Semler Brossy compensation consultant engagement is disclosed and cleared of conflicts — no related-party issue. No SPVs, JVs, investments, or off-balance-sheet entities are mentioned in this section.
